thread:
nina: Heads-up: support ticket about micro-duplicate charges when streams truncate multiple times and toolcalls interleave. impacted account reported 4 tiny extra tokens across several reconnects.
omar: Ugh. Do we have a trace ID?
nina: yes session=hq-2026, trace=hq-2026-7. timeline:
```
12:05:10 REQ session=hq-2026 route=eu-main prefix=20
12:05:12 STREAM_TRUNC session=hq-2026 trunc=1 provisional=true emit_id=A
12:05:13 TOOLCALL start session=hq-2026 tool=kb_lookup
12:05:13 STREAM_TRUNC session=hq-2026 trunc=2 provisional=true emit_id=B
12:05:14 ROUTE_SWAP session=hq-2026 to=eu-fallback
12:05:16 STREAM_RESUME session=hq-2026 resumed=24 confirmed=true confirm_refs=[A,B]
12:05:16 BILL provisional: 20+1+2 (route=eu-main)
12:05:17 BILL confirmed: 24 route=eu-fallback
```
nina: UI ends up showing provisional sum (23) + confirmed (24) -> user sees 47 token activity; actual net should be 24 + toolcall tokens.
celine: wait confirm_refs=[A,B] in the resume log suggests the confirmer saw the two provisional emits, but ledger still has them as separate provisional ledger lines and we didn't collapse them when producing the final net. Are we double-counting because provisional entries are persisted as independent credits and then confirmed stored as separate credits rather than an overwrite/delta?
omar: ledger model currently is append-only: provisional rows + confirmed rows. Reconciliation job normally collapses provisional vs confirmed by matching (session, seq, route). but here multiple provisional emits (emit_id A & B) complicate the matching—our confirmer treats confirmed as covering the latest provisional only.
anya: billing-bot: orphaned_provisional_alert session=hq-2026 count=2
tyler: proposal: introduce a provisional_group_id per session that all provisional emits append to (grouping multiple small truncates). confirmed events reference the same group_id and we compute net = confirmed_stream_tokens - sum(provisionals_in_group) then persist a single reconciled delta row. This avoids multiple provisional rows sticking around.
celine: we also need to handle partial confirmations: e.g., a resume that confirms only some earlier provisional emits (maybe because of partial replay). group semantics need to support partial consumption. i suggest provisional entries include a sequence number and group_id; confirms include what seq range they cover. confirmer will reduce matched provisionals by seq range and emit reconciliation entries accordingly.
omar: sounds good. DB index: (session, group_id) -> list of provisionals. extra storage but manageable. UI: customers want transparency. add a collapsed view with an expand chevron that shows original provisional lines and final reconciliation lines. keep audit csvs fully detailed.
anya: short-term mitigation: if we detect multiple provisional emits within a very short window (<=5s) for same session, mark them as "coalesced provisional" in analytics and don't push immediate provisional billing to customer-facing ledger until either a timeout or confirm arrives. This reduces visible noise but delays provisional visibility.
tyler: meh, cautious with delaying charges; some users rely on provisional to approximate cost in near real-time. prefer the group_id approach as primary fix and coalescing heuristic as fall-back toggle per-customer via billing flags.
nina: testing: e2e scenarios: 1) multi-truncate before resume on same route 2) multi-truncate + toolcall + route-swap 3) partial confirm where only subset of provisionals are included. assert ledger net matches expected and audit trail clickable to original emits.
elisa-bot: Info: reconciliation_job_pending_for_session=hq-2026
celine: migration/backfill: run job to scan last 7 days for sessions with >1 provisional per session and unresolved confirms, then run group-reconcile logic. We should also surface a small manual ops tool to create credits per-customer when automated backfill is ambiguous.
omar: telemetry: emit metric provisional_group_unmatched_ratio and recon_time_ms. set alert if >0.2% for high spend customers.
anya: follow-ups: tyler -> implement group_id + confirm range matching (owner), celine -> UI collapsed/expand audit UX, omar -> ledger index migration & backfill plan, nina -> coordinate support comms and ops run.
nina: thanks all. I'll paste the support ticket link and mark support to wait for reconciliation before refunding.
